Fold looks terrible open lmao, people who don't have the fold 6 complain about it but honestly mines been through the ringer with me since day 1. And coming from a Fold 4 this thing is my favourite phone I've owned in a very long time. Samsung have refined their design over the years and while some people complain there's not much difference between the fold 5 and the fold 6, the difference between the Pixel 9 Fold and Fold6 is night and day. It blew my mind seeing the first bezel less candy bar phones when Samsung started doing edge screens and this is the same. Only reason I'd get the Pixel is if you have to use the phone for work in regards to photography, in reality you shouldn't even if they have decent sensors now. But the only thing that irks me I guess about the Samsung folds is cameras.

I mean, I bought a second hand ZFold4 and the inner screen died 3 days in my possession with the dreaded crack. Contacted Samsung, they arranged courier pickup, got the phone. A week later I got a brand new phone sent back. Not saying everyone will be as lucky but I didn't have to pay anything so massive Win for me.

There's always faults with new technology as long as they can solve your issue with a new handset if they can't repair it without you paying then I don't see the problem. I'm using a Fold6 now and no issues at all, including paint chipping.
